title: The Carry-on Kit

That’s the power of the Carry-on Kit.

title: E-Gift card
description:
Give the gift of a sustainable wardrobe and let them choose their forever pieces.

Looking for a last minute gift? Or a gift with zero carbon footprint? Encircled digital eGift Cards are the perfect option if you don't know the style or size of the person you're shopping for!

Gift cards can be sent immediately, or scheduled for a later date.

How to Setup your E-Gift Card:

  1. Select the denomination of e-gift card you want to purchase. Note: Our gift cards are in Canadian Dollars but translate to your local currency.
  2. Click "Send Gift Card", a pop-up will open.
  3. In the pop-up, you can select a graphic for the gift card.
  4. You can decide to send the gift card to yourself (we're not judging!) or someone else. Simply enter the correct information in the box.
  5. Choose a delivery date - Send Now (sends immediately) or schedule for a later date
  6. Enter a gift note to the recipient
  7. Click "Send Card"
  8. Gift card will be added to cart and you can either proceed to checkout or shop and checkout later!

Notes about E-Gift Cards:

  • Gift cards have no cash value and cannot be returned or exchanged.
  • Promo codes don't apply on gift card purchases.
